title: Her Loss By Drake & 21 Savage Is Already A Classic, Says Nets' Forward Kevin Durant
htmlContent:
Last week Drake and 21 Savage dropped their project Her Loss, which of course, had the entertainment and music world talking after Drake took several shots at Serena Williams' husband, Alexis Ohanian, by calling him a 'Groupie,' and Kanye West and the fake truths that they made because of J-Prince. He also took jabs at Megan Thee Stallion and Dram, to name a few.

Since 'Her Loss' was released, it has had some screaming. It's the album of the year, and it's a project you don't skip over any of the tracks. However, if you ask Nets forward Kevin Durant, it's already a classic project.

In a recent interview with Chris 'See Hendo' Henderson, Durant was asked about the Drake and 21 Savage's latest project.

"It's a classic already. It's one of the ones that we've been waiting on. It's has all types of music on there," said Durant.

"You know Drizzy and 21 will come with it with the bars. So, I'm satisfied, man I think it's going to last me throughout the whole year

Kevin Durant recently also

"Regardless of each team's record, there’s always going to be a rivalry," Durant told reporters after the game. "Regardless of who’s on the floor, there’s always going to be a rivalry because of the fans here in New York City. They’re so passionate and love sports so much that there’s always going to be competition. 

"As long as I got a Nets' jersey on, if I see a Knicks fan, I'm always gonna give them a thumbs down or just give them some s--- about being a Knicks fan."
